question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: a. Where was Antonio in Venice? i) In free area ii) In trial room iii) In police van iv) In Shylock’s house b. What are they waiting for? i) Trial ii) Duke iii) Court iv) Antonio c. Shylock was asked to be mercuui merciful to —. i. Bassanio ii. Antonio iii. The Duke iv. Balthazar d. Who did wish to help Antonio? i. Shylock ii. The Duke iii. God iv. People of Venice e. For whom was Portia in disguise? i Antonio ii. Clerk iii. The Duke iv. Bassanio f. Whom did Shylock hand the bond to? i. Portia ii. Balthazar iii. The Duke iv. Doctor g. What was not in the bond? i. Flesh ii. Blood iii. None iv. Pound of flesh Extra Practices h. Shylock was delighted because he —. i) could get the money ii) could get flesh iii) could win iv) could kill Antonio i. Antonio's life was saved by —. i. Balthazar ii. Portia iii. The Duke iv. The Judge j. Who was/were in disguise? i. Portia and the clerk ii. Portia iii. The clerk iv. The Duke
guide_solution: a. ii) In trial room; b. i) Trial; c. ii) Antonio; d. ii) the Duke; e. ii) Antonio; f. i) Portia; g. ii) blood; h. ii) could get flesh; i.ii) Portia; j. i) Portia and the clerk.

subject: English
stimulus: a. Who was Bassanio? b. Where was Antonio? c. Why was the Duke sorry? d. Was Shylock a bad man? e. Why did Portia take disguise? Extra Practices f. Who did Portia request to show mercy? g. Who does God love? h. How did Portia save Antonio's life? i. Why did Shylock not take the pound of flesh? j. What was mentioned in the bond?
guide_solution: a. Bassanio was Antonio's friend. b. Antonio was in the court of justice. c. The Duke was sorry because he could do nothing to help Antonio. d. Yes, Shylock was a bad man. He wanted flesh of a human body which is of course bad. e. Portia took disguise to help Antonio. f. Portia requested Shylock to show mercy. g. God loves them who are merciful. h. Portia saved Antonio's life by her wisdom. i. Shylock did not take the pound of flesh because it was not possible for him to cut flesh without blood-shed. j. Only the pound of flesh was mentioned in the bond.
